model_internal_preprocessing.note: The model applies its own preprocessing internally: Rescaling(1/255) -> Normalization -> Rescaling. Training therefore used deliberate double scaling. Never apply keras.applications.efficientnet.preprocess_input (or any ImageNet mean/std subtraction) to this model's inputs.

forbidden: BICUBIC/LANCZOS resize for the runtime path (training used flow_from_directory default: nearest)

training_reference.note: Training used ImageDataGenerator.flow_from_directory with default resize (nearest) at 224x224 and no rescale argument (the model rescales internally).
